top_signals.title: AI Skeptics Surrender Again as Traders Eye Path Forward for Tech
top_signals.summary: The road to the Nasdaq 100 Index’s first record since June was anything but straightforward. Now the equity bulls that helped drive the move are looking for evidence that momentum won’t peter out.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: South Korea Aims to Cut Middle East Crude Reliance to 50% by 2035
top_signals.summary: South Korea will try to cut its reliance on Middle East crude imports to 50% by 2035, Reuters has reported, citing the country’s industry ministry. The ministry has drafted a 10-year natural resource security plan, which envisages a “fundamental shift” in the way South Korea sources its imports. The plan also calls for a boost in oil reserves by some 20 million barrels by 2030. South Korea imports as much as 70% of its crude oil from Middle Eastern producers, and most of it must pass through the Strait of Hormuz, the ministry…
